theme: Personal finance basics: emergency fund, 50/30/20 budgeting, good vs bad debt
headline: Building Your Emergency Fund First
body: An emergency fund covers unexpected expenses. Aim for three to six months of living costs before investing.
caption: Your emergency fund is your financial safety net. It prevents taking on bad debt during unexpected situations. Keep this separate from your investing goals. #EmergencyFund #PersonalFinance #MoneyManagement #FinancialBasics #SmartSaving
